      "evidence": "Carries the Mining label and modifies interfaces::Mining and IPC block submission methods.",

      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Adds an atomic `precious` flag to `Mining.submitBlock` and `BlockTemplate.submitSolution` so external miners do not need a separate racy RPC call to prefer same-work blocks. External miners benefit from the interface completeness, but it is deferrable."
